parent_objective: execute measured source-expanded calibrated scale-up over fixed 864-cell matrix
blocked_by: need measured execution before scale-up result audit
supersedes: direct calibrated scale-up result audit without execution

public_gates: M1715 must execute exactly the M1712 864-cell scale-up matrix
M1715 must write episode, failure, state, variant, outcome, termination, task-family, source-edge, profile, and profile-outcome artifacts
M1715 must preserve scale_up_variant_label and scale_up_workload_id in episode rows
M1715 must keep all selected metrics finite and failure_count zero for an execution pass
M1715 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1715 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: executes fixed-budget source-expanded calibrated scale-up after design-only admission
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public diagnostic task-quality execution only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if selected metrics are non-finite
stop if required variant or outcome aggregates are missing
fallback_plan: route to runner repair if execution plumbing fails
route to M1716 result audit if execution passes
route to task-quality repair design if scale-up is off-track dominated or collision-tradeoff dominated
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1714 admits calibrated scale-up measured execution

admission_evidence: M1714 pre-registers scale-up execution artifacts and audit thresholds
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: scale-up execution runner or adapter if needed
M1715 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: variant and outcome aggregates are present
execution pass/fail is recorded without interpreting profile rank

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1715 is a task-quality diagnostic execution and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: execution matrix preserves L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset controls for later audit
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If calibrated variants do not improve task quality under collision guards, record as task-quality calibration evidence rather than self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: no training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1712 source-expanded calibrated scale-up matrix can be executed as a fixed public diagnostic run with complete variant/outcome aggregates and no guardrail violations.
success_criteria: scale_up_variant_aggregate.csv exists and includes all four labels
scale_up_workload_id and scale_up_variant_label are preserved in episode rows
training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
controller-family ranking or level3 claims are made
decision_rule: M1715 passes as execution plumbing if the 864 scale-up episodes complete with finite metrics, zero failures, complete aggregates, and no guardrail violations. Result interpretation is deferred to M1716.
